item: Statistics ingest flushes its new sources
summary: The session does not autoflush, so the domain check could not see a row added earlier in the same call (two agencies on one domain gave two sources) and a caller reading back in its own session counted none. test_ingest_is_idempotent failed when run alone (29 == 0) and passed after any test that had already ingested. The ingest now flushes each new row; a new test pins both.
